description: What is new since the user last caught up: new workouts, finished nights, recovery samples, plan items (from set_plan) in the review window as done / missed / pending by DATE (any workout on a planned date counts as done), daysSinceLastSession. Toward Suunto it only reads. The first call looks back 7 days; later ones start at the review window's first day (at most 14 days back; older goes into notes unread). 'New' means after the marker in ~/.suunto-mcp/seen.json (SUUNTO_SEEN_PATH overrides it). markSeen false (default) is a PURE READ: nothing is written, the same call repeats the same answer. Pass markSeen: true only once the user has actually been told: it moves the markers of the sections read, but the review window moves only when EVERY section was read (no entry in `errors`); more workouts than one call reads: call again with markSeen: true. An unreadable seen.json is an error, never overwritten. A night still being recorded and naps are not reported. Demo mode keeps the marker in memory. Annotated not read-only only because markSeen: true writes that marker.

markSeen.description: true: move the marker to what this answer covers (only after telling the user). Default false: leave it.

name: get_catchup
title: Catch up: what is new since last time
